title: Ratsasan
desc: Following his father's death, a man gives up on his dream to become a filmmaker and joins the police force. He then attempts to track down a psychopathic killer who targets schoolgirls.

title: Chinna Thambi
desc: After an astrologer predicts that their sister will marry a man of her own choosing, three protective brothers go to dire lengths to prevent the prophecy from being fulfilled.

title: Baashha
desc: Bound by a promise to his late father, a gangster becomes an autorickshaw driver. However, when his past catches up with him, he must choose between succumbing to his old ways and keeping his word.

title: Rajini Murugan
desc: Rajini Murugan loves Karthika, but her father objects to their alliance due to a confusion.

title: Pokkiri
desc: Thamizh, an undercover officer posing as a hitman, falls for Shruthi, who disapproves of his violent lifestyle. Their growing bond faces risks from his hidden mission.
